findings.problem: Retry-After:2 was initially validated only against a client deadline more than 500ms away, and replay timing was compared to that same client-derived value; a one-second parser error could falsely pass.
findings.sourceCorrection: Fixture now records independent server issuedAt/notBefore=issuedAt+2000, rejects early replays, requires stored client deadline at least the server bound, and validates actual replay timestamp against both bounds plus zero early replays.

findings.problem: Failure before releasing the first held request could leave page.evaluate rejection unhandled when the context closed.
findings.sourceCorrection: Pending evaluation receives immediate rejection handling; finally always releases the barrier, awaits completion and records heldEvaluationDrained before context cleanup. A separate controlled failure-path CI step exercises failure while the first native lock/request is still held.

positiveFindings: Overlapping second tab must fail with ROUND_BUSY and generate no token; first action must produce exactly one spin POST and one debit/credit.

Accepted lost-response recovery requires reload-retained pending identity, zero new tokens on reload, replay-only retrieval of the original accepted round, unchanged request token and one debit/credit.
Unaccepted lost-request recovery requires replay,state,spin ordering; original and retried action bodies must match; exactly one token and one acceptance are required.
429 observation occurs while the second tab is already connected; its blocked recovery must cause no additional request and must read the newly persisted deadline.
Settled state disables new spin/AUTO until an authoritative state refresh.
Context-wide routing blocks foreign origins, unsupported paths and request methods; request actions are checked against explicit synthetic identity/model fields.
Each scenario owns and closes a fresh browser context; outer completion closes the browser.
Fixture is not a registered game or Player route; runtime default sessionStorage and existing financial gates are unchanged.
All identifiers/account values in this fixture are invented test data; no production credentials or account data were found in reviewed files.

validation.check: Root-owned workflow declares separate shared-recovery-browser job, ten-minute bound and always-upload artifact step

limitations: No new native browser run was executed by this peer review.
Fixture debit/credit counters are only an in-memory test oracle; they do not prove SQL isolation, durable ledger constraints or real-money settlement.
Only the four named cases are covered; cross-account ownership changes, browser process crash, BFCache and uncooperative tabs are outside this runner.
Existing shared-client unit tests and new native CI must remain required; assertions must not be relaxed to obtain a pass.
